blocks.text: My Life as a University Student
During my freshman and sophomore years in college, I made lots of friends and joined many clubs.
Once again, I was not interested in studying very hard.
When I was in high school, my dream was to be an English teacher, but I learned I was not very good at English, and I did not want to study hard enough to fulfill this dream.
I changed my major to Engineering and really liked it.
